title: Past the teacher
goals: Reach the way out at the top.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Dask walks up and down the corridor, looking ahead.
# Wait while he looks your way, then cross.
wizard.wait()
hints: Watch which way Dask looks as he walks.
`wizard.wait()` lets one tick go by while you stay hidden.
A `while` loop can keep waiting while `dask.facing` is `"left"`.
intro: Back and forth, all night long. Cross while my back is turned, and not a moment before.
